column7: a resumed accept-loss (an unfinished acceptance, or a completed one rolled back to look unfinished) writes nothing on --confirm alone: AcceptAuditLoss refuses a resume plan unless the request names the record digest the plan prints (--resume-seal), so a habitual re-run cannot complete a record the operator did not read (AUDIT-SEAL-TAILS-3; also TestAuditSeal_ResumeNeedsRecordDigest, TestAcceptLoss_ResumeNeedsResumeSeal)
